jobs.title: Program Manager, Performance and Talent Planning
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a significant amount of work ahead. That means you have an opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Performance and Talent Planning team is part of Stripe’s broader Talent and Development organization. We shape how Stripes grow their careers and do their best work.

We build the programs, systems, and insights that help managers develop strong teams, help leaders plan for the future, and give Stripes clear opportunities to grow. Our work spans performance, talent planning, career development, succession, and organizational insights. Our goal is to make Stripe a place where talented people can build lasting careers and have an outsized impact.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will help translate Stripe’s performance and talent philosophy into scalable, global experiences. You will work across People Products, People Insights, Employee Relations, People Partners and other partner teams to design programs and systems that are clear for users, operationally durable, and aligned with Stripe’s future needs. You will bring a product mindset to all you do, starting with data driven problem statements, qualitative and quantitative signals, an understanding of the end-to-end user experience, an iterative design process, and an obsession with continuous improvement over time. You will be comfortable operating across time zones and navigating competing perspectives, incomplete information, and urgent priorities.

A Day in the Life

You start your day by reviewing your agenda in Slack or asking your AI agent to summarize ongoing work and priorities. Energized by a mix of workstream meetings across People Products, Manager Enablement, and M&A Transitions, you check overnight updates from teammates across time zones. Colleagues in Dublin have shared feedback that keeps the launch plan moving, while teammates in Melbourne have raised thoughtful questions about how a new performance process will integrate into the existing reporting capabilities they rely on for annual talent planning.

These questions are exactly the kind of challenge you value. They push you to build with a user-first mindset, anticipate downstream impacts, and mitigate risks before they emerge. You draw on expertise from across the organization while balancing the responsibility of integrating global perspectives, designing seamless end-to-end experiences, and coordinating work across interconnected teams. A new question sparks a new connection, and you quickly identify another stakeholder who should be brought into the next phase of the program.

As the day progresses, updates from cross-functional partners show steady progress across multiple fronts, but one critical area stalls. Rather than waiting for next week's meeting, you escalate immediately to keep momentum high and de-risk the program timeline. You end the day energized by the complexity of the work, the curiosity and collaboration of your colleagues, and the opportunity to continue to build, solve, and innovate every day.

Responsibilities

Drive and scale Stripe’s performance philosophy and practices. Design and improve performance experiences that help Stripes understand expectations, grow through feedback, and make meaningful contributions.
Evolve performance and talent tooling. Partner with People Products and cross-functional stakeholders to translate program needs into scalable systems, processes, and user journeys.
Strengthen career growth and talent investment. Help shape the programs, mechanisms, and insights that enable career development, talent planning, succession, and thoughtful investment in Stripe’s people as the company grows.
Lead complex, cross-functional workstreams. Build alignment among global stakeholders; surface risks and dependencies early; make progress in ambiguous environments; and unblock critical decisions quickly.
Use insights to improve outcomes. Define clear problem statements, gather qualitative and quantitative data, and use those insights to refine strategy, programs, and execution.

Who you are

You are a systems thinker who can connect the details of a program or product experience to the broader organizational context. You are energized by ambiguity and complexity, and thrive in bringing just enough structure, clarity, and strong momentum to the work. You build trusted relationships, communicate directly and thoughtfully, and create accountability across teams, with speed.

Minimum Requirements

10+ years of experience building and scaling global People or HR experiences, with experience across both process and product or systems design
Experience leading complex programs in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where high ownership and cross-functional problem solving are expected.
Strong systems thinking: the ability to understand how people, processes, tools, policies, and organizational decisions influence one another over time and how to augment workflows and processes using AI tools.
A demonstrated ability to build enduring, trusted stakeholder relationships; communicate effectively across levels and functions; and establish clear decision-making and accountability mechanisms.
A disciplined approach to problem solving. You begin with the “why,” define and refine problem statements steeped in both quantitative and qualitative data, and continuously ask “is this the right problem to solve, at the right time?”
High agency and sound judgment. You identify opportunities or risks, take action quickly, and escalate thoughtfully when progress is blocked.
Deep alignment with Stripe’s Operating Principle, Obsess over Talent. You believe that people are one of Stripe’s greatest unlocks: attracting exceptional talent, creating environments where they can thrive, building systems that support growth, and recognizing meaningful contributions.
Curiosity and humility. You are a continuous learner who seeks to understand before acting, welcomes ideas from many sources, and is willing to change course when new evidence suggests a better path.

Preferred Qualifications

10+ years of experience across a diverse portfolio of People programs: talent management, organizational development, leadership and/or executive development, program and talent operations, and compensation and benefits
People product design and management experience in high growth environments with fast iterative cycles, changing priorities, and a steady stream of feature requests and backlog
Experience and excellence leading executive level talent discussions that influence People strategy, with humility, curiosity, and a grounded presence

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $129,400 - $194,200. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

You start your day by reviewing your agenda in Slack or asking your AI agent to summarize ongoing work and priorities. Lead complex, cross-functional workstreams. Build alignment among global stakeholders; surface risks and dependencies early; make progress in ambiguous environments; and unblock critical decisions quickly.
Use insights to improve outcomes. Define clear problem statements, gather qualitative and quantitative data, and use those insights to refine strategy, programs, and execution.

You are a systems thinker who can connect the details of a program or product experience to the broader organizational context. You are energized by ambiguity and complexity, and thrive in bringing just enough structure, clarity, and strong momentum to the work. You build trusted relationships, communicate directly and thoughtfully, and create accountability across teams, with speed.

10+ years of experience building and scaling global People or HR experiences, with experience across both process and product or systems design
Experience leading complex programs in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where high ownership and cross-functional problem solving are expected.
Strong systems thinking: the ability to understand how people, processes, tools, policies, and organizational decisions influence one another over time and how to augment workflows and processes using AI tools.
A demonstrated ability to build enduring, trusted stakeholder relationships; communicate effectively across levels and functions; and establish clear decision-making and accountability mechanisms.
A disciplined approach to problem solving. You begin with the “why,” define and refine problem statements steeped in both quantitative and qualitative data, and continuously ask “is this the right problem to solve, at the right time?”
High agency and sound judgment. You identify opportunities or risks, take action quickly, and escalate thoughtfully when progress is blocked.
Deep alignment with Stripe’s Operating Principle, Obsess over Talent. You believe that people are one of Stripe’s greatest unlocks: attracting exceptional talent, creating environments where they can thrive, building systems that support growth, and recognizing meaningful contributions.
Curiosity and humility. You are a continuous learner who seeks to understand before acting, welcomes ideas from many sources, and is willing to change course when new evidence suggests a better path.

People product design and management experience in high growth environments with fast iterative cycles, changing priorities, and a steady stream of feature requests and backlog

If you thrive where analytics, problem-solving, and supporting others meet, this role offers ownership, visibility, and the chance to influence how Gusto sells health insurance.

About The Team

The HI Sales Operations team partners closely with sales leadership to support two dynamic, fast-moving sales teams that contribute meaningfully to Gusto's growth. We think of ourselves as builders, problem solvers, and strategic partners; we turn uncertainty into clarity and fragmented processes into scalable, repeatable systems.

Our work spans quotas, pipeline health, forecasting, process design, data integrity, account and territory administration, go-to-market strategy, and increasingly, AI-driven optimization. We value curiosity, open communication, and a commitment to helping 80+ sales reps operate efficiently and confidently.

Here’s What You’ll Do Day-to-day

Analytics, Reporting & Forecasting

Build, automate, and maintain reports and dashboards that track sales performance, funnel metrics, pipeline health, SLAs, and rep productivity; keep definitions consistent and documentation clear.
Partner with RevOps, Finance, Marketing, and Analytics to produce operational reporting, revenue insights, and forecasting models across the weekly forecast, monthly reviews, and QBR cadence.
Own metric definitions and data accuracy so leaders trust the numbers they act on.

Drive AI Strategy for Sales

Identify and prototype AI and automation tools, such as content generation, analytics copilots, and call coaching, that remove manual friction from the sales process.
Partner with Sales, BizTech, Product, and Enablement to embed AI into daily sales workflows, improving both efficiency and effectiveness.
Source and lead net-new AI and automation projects, connecting data insights to process improvements that lift rep productivity.

Process Design & Continuous Improvement

Examine workflows and rep performance to identify bottlenecks; recommend and implement process and automation changes that improve conversion, efficiency, and the rep experience.
Partner with Sales Enablement to document processes, build playbooks, and drive adoption of new tools and workflows.

Operational Support & Problem-Solving

Provide day-to-day support to HI Sales leadership and reps: ad hoc data requests, process issues, and one-off investigations.
Own account and territory administration as the business evolves, assignment and coverage upkeep, book reassignments for leave and departures, large-scale account rerouting, and segment reclassification, supported by lead-routing and round-robin automation.
Support territory, quota, and coverage planning, plus monthly sales-compensation reconciliation.
Troubleshoot reporting issues, broken workflows, missing CRM data, and gaps in pipeline visibility with fast, accurate fixes.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Communication

Work closely with Sales Leadership, RevOps, Finance, BizTech, and Product to keep everyone aligned and remove obstacles to progress.
Translate sales challenges into clear business requirements; partner cross-functionally to design solutions and durable improvements.
Keep stakeholders aligned with clear, regular updates to managers and senior leadership on timelines, risks, and outcomes.
Act as a trusted advisor, bringing structure, insight, and clarity to complex or ambiguous problems.

Here’s What We're Looking For

5+ years in Sales Ops, RevOps, or a similar analytical GTM role; ideally in a fast-paced SaaS or fintech environment.
Strong Salesforce proficiency; you can spot data issues, audit pipeline problems, manage account ownership and routing, and build reports and dashboards that reps and leaders actually use.
Analytical depth across Salesforce reports and dashboards, SQL, Tableau or Looker, and Excel/Google Sheets.
Hands-on experience with forecasting, pipeline management, and territory or quota planning on a recurring cadence; for example, a weekly forecast feeding monthly reviews and QBRs.
Comfort evaluating AI and automation tools and prototyping simple workflows to improve productivity.
Excellent written and verbal communication; you simplify complex information and create alignment from frontline reps to senior directors.
A first-principles problem solver who breaks down ambiguous issues, tests hypotheses, and builds structured solutions.
Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented, you manage multiple projects and recurring workflows while protecting data quality and operational reliability.
A strong partner to sales, with a track record supporting teams that have competing, fast-changing priorities.
